body.name: Compact rational Airy longitudinal family
body.construction:
Put \(\Phi=\phi_{c^\dagger}\), \(\kappa=\kappa(c^\dagger)=5/8\), and
\[
d_\dagger(f,\Phi)^2
=\int_{\mathbb R}\left\{|f'-\Phi'|^2+(1+|x|)|f-\Phi|^2\right\}dx.
\]
Fix an enumeration by natural-number codes of all pairs \((T,p)\) for which \(T\) is a positive integer and \(p\) is an even, continuous, compactly supported piecewise-linear function supported in \([-T,T]\), with rational breakpoints and rational polynomial coefficients on every piece.  For \(k\ge1\), let
\[
\eta_k=\min\!\left\{2^{-k},
\frac{2^{-k}}{8\|\Phi'\|_2+4+2\kappa\||x|^{1/2}\Phi\|_2+\kappa}\right\}.
\]
Define \((T_k^\dagger,\varphi_k^\dagger)\) to be the first pair in this enumeration satisfying \(d_\dagger(\varphi_k^\dagger,\Phi)\le\eta_k\), using the zero function on \([-1,1]\) only as a default if no such pair exists.  When \(\int(\varphi_k^\dagger)^2>0\), set
\[
w_k^\dagger(x)=\frac{\varphi_k^\dagger(x)^2}
 {\int_{\mathbb R}\varphi_k^\dagger(z)^2dz};
\]
on the unused default branch set \(w_k^\dagger(x)=\mathbf1\{|x|\le1\}/2\).
